findings: Exports hash-many, compress-in-place, compress-XOF and XOF-many with plain/underscore aliases. ELF GNU-stack/CET and Apple section conditionals remain in this Unix variant. Only hash-many entry/core prefix read so far.
Hash-many saves six SysV nonvolatile general registers, reserves144 bytes and aligns stack64. Increment mask derives from negated R9 and kmovw K1; caller boolean contract matters.

Counter initialization computes two eight-lane low32 vectors for offsets0..15, uses unsigned mask comparisons to add carry to corresponding high32 lanes, then replaces lanes with original counter under inverse increment mask. Four32-byte vectors occupy first128 stack bytes.

Block count shifts6 to byte length stored at0x80; flags at0x88. Main branch requires16 inputs. First/start and final/end flags surround full64-byte block loop. Zero-block behavior for nonzero inputs remains a caller-precondition question pending rest.

Sixteen-input setup reads each64-byte block as two32-byte loads, combines input pairs into ZMM lanes and transposes via unpack/shuffle plus INDEX0/INDEX1-controlled vpermt2d/vpermi2d. Indices/constants themselves remain unread.

Round prefix uses ZMM0..31 and native vprord rotations16/12/8/7. Initial256-bit EVEX masking already needs AVX512VL-capable configuration; shorter vector widths do not imply an AVX2-safe path. Actual dispatch and runtime parity are separate gates.
